notes.title: Dark Symphony Store Page Released!
notes.content:
Hello all,

After months of development, I decided to publish the store page for the game I've been working on, [b]Dark Symphony[/b]. 

The idea for the game came to me in the shower. I was listening to [i]"Lincolnshire Posy,"[/i] a six-movement piece by Percy Grainger. I played trumpet in high school and was reminiscing about this piece we played. I'm a big fan of horror games, and cogs were turning in my head. After getting out of the shower, I knew I would create a horror game with a posy-obsessed man, whether it took a couple of months or even years.

Several months after that shower, we're here! I've spent 100+ hours thinking about and developing this thing, and I look forward to many more so that you and I are both pleased with the final product.

[h1]Wishlist Now :)[/h1]

Here is a funny video taken much earlier in the development cycle. Thank you for following my journey!
